summary: A couple hiking from the Mad Creek trailhead toward Elk Park in the Steamboat Springs wilderness were caught by a weather change (rain, sun, and snow) wearing only shorts and t-shirts; cold, wet, and tired after trudging through deep snow, they called for help. Routt County SAR spent about ten hours reaching them and, given their clothing and the time already spent out, called in a helicopter to extract the pair and some rescuers.
location: Mad Creek trailhead to Elk Park, Steamboat Springs
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: story says 'Sunday' with no calendar date; SnowBrains page last-updated metadata resolves to 2021-05-04 (Tuesday), pinning the incident Sunday to 2021-05-02. Four rescuers walked back, reaching base at 2 am; incident commander Kristia Check-Hill.
